page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The lack of local storage and the low RAM-to-vCPU ratio represent key architectural tradeoffs, prioritizing raw CPU capacity and network throughput over local data caching or memory-intensive operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c7.32xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute cores relative to memory, making it a viable option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include high-traffic web serving, batch processing, video encoding, and distributed compute tasks.
